task.interrupted: This run was interrupted by a process restart (marked during startup recovery).

jobs.cancelledSaved: Task cancelled; reusable progress has been saved

jobs.handlerUnavailable: This version cannot run this task type. Update MovieClaw and try again.

jobs.conflict: An identical task is already running
jobs.dismissFailedOnly: Only failed tasks can be dismissed. Cancel tasks that are still running.
